segs.text: Questions 35 through 37 refer to the following conversation.
Hello, this is Yolanda Mendez calling from Room 506. I wanted to do some sightseeing today,
so I'm wondering how to get to the Modern Art Museum on foot.
Well, the museum is fairly close to our hotel, about half an hour's walk.
